claims: C1: scopes should be recorded in a semi-structured format
C2: the semi-structured format is a ScopeOfAutonomy record with fields allowed_tools, latest_time, max_cost, tool_constraints, additional_details
C3: recording scopes in this format facilitates validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: S is a scope of autonomy, a clear boundary of what the assistant may do and when it must pause for clarification or approval

concepts.name: semi_structured_record
concepts.gloss: S is recorded in a semi-structured format, i.e. a ScopeOfAutonomy record with fields allowed_tools, latest_time, max_cost, tool_constraints, additional_details

concepts.name: facilitates_validation_auditing
concepts.gloss: recording S in this format facilitates validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform

ontology.gloss: S is recorded in a semi-structured format
the ScopeOfAutonomy record for S has an allowed_tools field
the ScopeOfAutonomy record for S has a latest_time field
the ScopeOfAutonomy record for S has a max_cost field
the ScopeOfAutonomy record for S has a tool_constraints field
the ScopeOfAutonomy record for S has an additional_details field

asserts.read_back: recording a scope of autonomy in a semi-structured format is preferred because it facilitates validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform

closure.reason: the clause recommends a semi-structured format for scopes but does not prohibit other formats; recording a scope in any format is not forbidden by this clause
